note: cwd values are read from transcript records, never reverse-derived from the well name. strict=true means the cwd comes from a session whose every record carries the SAME cwd (no cd, no worktree relocation) so it is unambiguously the shard key: assert directory(forCwd: cwd) == well. strict=false wells have no such session; for those assert only that SOME entry of cwds encodes to well — a per-record cwd is the session current directory, not the shard key.
normalization: cwd arrives NFC in transcripts even when the directory on disk is NFD (probe well -Users-rf-studio-cc-test-caf--nfd: dir is 34 chars NFD, the recorded cwd is 33 chars NFC). Normalize to NFC before encoding — on an NFD path a per-scalar encoder emits "cafe--nfd" and a per-grapheme one "caf--nfd", and only the second matches the harness.
